ActorTalk: I don't recognize your signature. What's your business in F.O.S.?!
Your silence is noted, but meaningless. My strongest backup is already on the way!
Alpha?
This is your "strongest backup"?
That's ri— Wait, that look you just exchanged... don't tell me you two know each other?
We do, but it's...
Alpha, why are you...
...Get this metal chunk out of our way, and I'll tell you everything you want to know.
What are you doing at F.O.S.?
I'll explain later.
Well, you could've mentioned you know the Gray Raven Commandant. That changes things.
Then move.
Not so fast. I can't permit an unchecked person to roam F.O.S. freely... unless...
Unless what?
Unless they're under proper supervision.
What are these?
Tactical restraint cuffs, specialized gear for containing high-risk targets. Made from the latest high-tensile alloy, top of the line.
"High-risk targets"... including the Gray Raven Commandant?
Young people these days only hear what they want to hear. I said someone needs to supervise, didn't I?
You want me to be her supervisor?
Coincidentally, I was asked to field-test these anyway. Fine, I'll authorize this unregistered Construct's limited movement within the academy.
But you must stay by her side as her supervisor, to prevent any... incidents.
So that means we can move freely now?
Do you really have to cuff me too?
Exactly! Just wrap up your business and meet me at the Monument Plaza. I'll remove the cuffs then.
An instructor's orders are absolute! Once you're done, come find me at the Monument Plaza to get unlocked!
Let's go.
Wait... You still haven't told me why you're really here.
...My previous engagements at F.O.S. left significant data traces behind.
If I don't delete them, someone could track me later, or worse, replicate something from them.
So you're only here to delete data?
Believe what you want. That's my only business here today. Nothing more.
I believe you.
If I didn't, I couldn't supervise you properly, could I?
...Then let's move. That data's been sitting too long. I'd rather not encounter surprises.
Heh, ready to move out now, Supervisor?
Let's go delete that data.
